snippet.title: Mail Mole - 'Xpress Deliveries Expansion - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Mail Mole is back this with a free content update: Xpress Deliveries!

➡️Download on #eShop: http://bit.ly/3uMFCWG
➡️Download on #Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273540/Mail_Mole/

➡️Discord: http://discord.gg/Y4RRxxX


Mail Mole returns with a free content update named 'Xpress Deliveries! Get your mailbag ready to take on the new speed-focused extra missions, unlock a brand new collection of costumes from your favorite indie games, try them on and create summer postcards with the new photo mode and challenge the best players with the new Boss Rush Mode and Speedrun Options.
